project_details: Rooftop solar project. Budget ceiling and completion limit are listed in the criteria.

criteria.looking_for: The bidder itself must hold an Ontario electrical contractor licence, and its proposal must say so
WSIB clearance and $5M liability insurance, both confirmed
Count of past commercial jobs sized 100 kW and up, completed since 2021-01-01. Value is the count.
Total price in CAD. Value is the amount. Budget ceiling is 260000.
Weeks to complete from award. Value is the number of weeks. Limit is 16.
Panel and workmanship warranty length in years
Named project lead, crew, safety plan and monitoring plan. Use status ambiguous for a lead described as named when no name appears.
